scope: Live-device SafeSPI frames used as the conformance fixture for core/protocol.
purpose: Every consumer of the SCH16T links one protocol implementation. These frames are what the
device actually accepted and returned on the bench, so a decode or CRC change that would
diverge from the qualified wire behaviour fails here before it can reach a vehicle.
The frames are transcribed verbatim from the bring-up evidence records; core owns this copy
and does not read the evidence archive at build or test time.

sources.scope: Post-power-cycle identity and SPI read-path qualification at 1 MHz.
Bounded polling initialization, status qualification, ten-sample acquisition.
Autonomous soft-reset recovery from a deterministically malformed response state.

identity_read_commands.note: The seven-command identity cycle as sent on the wire. Frames 1 and 2 repeat ASIC_ID and frames 5 and 6 repeat SN_ID3 because SafeSPI replies are out of frame: a response arrives one command late, so the last request must be issued twice to read it back.

identity_response_cycle.note: Response frames carrying the identity words this device returned. The COMP_ID/ASIC_ID/serial values are the live ones; frame 0 is the priming reply and is never inspected.

validated_status_responses.note: Ten status responses the device returned after configuration, every one CRC-valid with the all-ones normal status word. Presented to the eleven-frame validator behind a zero priming frame, exactly as the acquisition path does.

bringup_write_sequence.note: The complete ten-frame write sequence the functional probe put on the wire. It uses the bring-up filter generation (CTRL_FILT_ACC12/ACC3 = 0x01FF), not the qualified flight configuration, so it is a framing and CRC vector rather than a configuration expectation. Each entry pins sch16t_make_write_frame(address, value) against a frame the device accepted.

flight_config_write_commands.note: The qualified flight configuration manifest: seven writes, in order, that sch16t_config_write_commands() must produce. It differs from the bring-up sequence only in the two accelerometer filter words, which the qualified configuration leaves at 0x0000 (LPF0, 68 Hz). CTRL_USER_IF is deliberately absent.
flight_config_write_commands.operating_constraint: Do not write CTRL_USER_IF = 0x0020 in the polling path. DRY_SYNC is unnecessary there and that write reproducibly disrupted subsequent SafeSPI responses on this unit until soft reset (config_stage_evidence, 2026-08-02).

sequences.note: The soft reset is a single write; the reset-recovery record shows one such frame restored stable identity and CRC-valid reads without cycling the vehicle's shared 3.3 V rail. EOI closes the configuration transaction after EN_SENSOR.

crc_vectors.note: Every frame above is a CRC vector. These two additionally pin single-bit corruption detection: the first is a frame the device returned, the second is that frame with its lowest CRC bit flipped.

scale_contract.note: Datasheet sensitivities for the maximum-range K01 configuration the flight config words select. Consumers convert to SI with these and nothing else.
scale_contract.temperature_decode: arithmetic right shift by 4, then 0.01 C per LSB
